q1: SELECT O1.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA O1 WHERE O1.FREE = 1 AND ((SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID - 1) = 1 OR (SELECT FREE FROM CINEMA O2 WHERE O2.SEAT_ID = O1.SEAT_ID + 1) = 1)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT A.SEAT_ID FROM CINEMA A INNER JOIN CINEMA B WHERE ABS(B.SEAT_ID-A.SEAT_ID)=1 AND A.FREE=1 AND B.FREE=1 ORDER BY A.SEAT_ID ASC

counterexample: INSERT INTO CINEMA (SEAT_ID, FREE) VALUES (1, TRUE), (2, FALSE), (3, TRUE);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 checks for seats that are free and have at least one adjacent seat that is also free, while Q2 checks for pairs of adjacent free seats.
